H_by_B.question: Can many severe bottlenecks collectively provide a representative return?

alpha_by_m.question: Does regional immigration erase or stabilize host-induced change?

fixed_parameters.regional_pool: same frozen composition as the focal start

required_to_1000.reason: no-immigration diagnostic and m=0.001 memory half-life of approximately 693 passages

adaptive_time_horizon.additional_extension_rule: extend a positive-feedback eligible cell, together with its same-m alpha=0 control, when either its raw TV or its paired host-induced TV change fails the frozen stability rule

stability_rule.uncertainty: paired 90% Student-t interval across 12 seed blocks
stability_rule.pass: the complete interval lies inside plus/minus the margin

adaptive_time_horizon.trajectory_integrity: all new TOMLs have host_generations=1000; execution pauses at 100 or 500 and resumes the same verified checkpoint
adaptive_time_horizon.scope_warning: adaptive extensions diagnose time dependence; they do not change the pre-specified passage-100 primary comparisons

analysis.seed_block_pairing: all contrasts and uncertainty preserve the 12 matched seeds

primary_endpoint.response: TV distance from the shared initial composition

H_by_B.comparison: compare HB-only fit with separate H, B and interaction; report beta_H and beta_B

candidate_models: separate alpha, m and alpha-by-m interaction
alpha_by_m.erasure: lower mean host-induced TV relative to the same-m control
alpha_by_m.stabilization: lower passages-51-100 temporal SD and/or lower among-seed variation, reported separately from erasure

registered_responses: within-population temporal SD of TV during passages 51-100
analysis.future_grid_additions: B=2 or B=20 require a separate reviewed design amendment if the frozen H-by-B surface shows important curvature
